# Fluent System Icons

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons/tree/a563cf9166f4f91aa617557ed272612b7f0a2f72

The session header uses the official 20px regular Lock Closed, Sign Out, Arrow Clockwise and Power icons, unmodified, in `quickshell/assets/icons/fluent/`. Source: Microsoft [Fluent System Icons](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons/tree/a563cf9166f4f91aa617557ed272612b7f0a2f72/assets), revision `a563cf9166f4f91aa617557ed272612b7f0a2f72`. License: `LICENSES/fluent-icons-MIT.txt`. QML applies the theme color at render time.
